effect_description_eng: ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) [When Digivolving] Trash all digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon can't attack until their turn ends. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon with as many digivolution cards as this Digimon or fewer are deleted, if you have [Valner Dragnogh], trash their top security card.
